cases.assertion_intent: The native executable exports JSON/JavaScript exactly byte-for-byte as the actual public service AsJSON/AsJS API, with successful exit and no stderr.
cases.adaptation: Build and invoke the real Go contextir executable for contract and contract -js. The original Python subprocess is not counted as Go merely because its expected value used a Go helper. Native contract version3 and its actual generated comment remain authoritative; source Python history is preserved.
cases.oracle: Actual production service.AsJSON()/AsJS() strings; comparison includes every byte and trailing newline; both subprocess modes execute.
